0022600120.text: The Timberwolves, now 2-0 with both wins on the road and a two-game winning streak, sit 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, while the Cavaliers are 1-1, 1-0 at home, and 2nd in the Central, one game back, and 8th in the East. Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on January 10, 2026 in Cleveland, where the Timberwolves lost 146-134.
